warmup_amendment: Before reading any performance timings or starting the cache-on run, the CPU-only deterministic sampler audit found both ranks see all 8 rows only after step 11. High-reuse warmup is therefore 12 steps; every run still has 32 steps and reports its full/cold cost. The first off run continues unchanged.
keepalive_during_experiment: User script runs during CPU service startup only; stop and wait for exact keeper PIDs as soon as a training CUDA context appears, before model forward. Record stop timestamp and verify it precedes first training step. Restart after terminal completion. Same policy for both modes.
reporting: Retain checkpoint steps and every repeat; report median, standard deviation and range. Failed runs are retained separately and never silently included as successful repeats.
